csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this Request for Fund Proposal ( RFP ) is to solicit applications for the development of Non- Congregate Shelter through the federal HOME-ARP Program. HOME-ARP defines NCS as one or more buildings that provide private units or rooms as temporary shelter to individuals and families and does not require occupants to sign a lease or occupancy agreement. The City of Bridgeport - Housing and Community Development - seeks to expand the availability of quality emergency shelter space, the desperate need for which is outlined in the city s HOME-ARP Allocation Plan, in order to better serve Bridgeport residents at the greatest need for emergency housing resources.
